title: Unisex Running – Mile One Was a Mistake. Embroidered Zip Hoodie

seo.title: Running Zip Up Hoodie – Mile One Was a Mistake.
seo.description: A running zip up hoodie: MILE ONE WAS A MISTAKE. on the back over a sweaty runner mid-stride, plus stitched MISTAKE. lettering on the chest.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

This running zip up hoodie is for the runner who regrets the first mile every single time and laces up again anyway, zipped on for the cold start line and the cooldown walk.

A sweaty, wide-eyed runner in a headband, an orange striped jersey, navy shorts and striped socks runs hard on a dirt path past a wooden post, in orange, cream, navy and tan with a worn print texture. MILE ONE runs above it and WAS A MISTAKE. below in two lines of heavy slab capitals, the last line wider than the first: navy and brick red on Ash, cream and coral on Black and Navy. The full print is on the back. On the front, a small MISTAKE. wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back is embroidered on the left chest, and the words MILE 1 are stitched on the left cuff, in white thread on Black and Navy and navy thread on Ash. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed and stitched the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Regular fit zip-up hoodie with a metal zipper
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece, soft inside and outside
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Embroidered left-chest MISTAKE. wordmark and left-cuff MILE 1, printed back
  • Front pouch pockets and an unlined hood with color-matched drawcord
  • Double-needle stitching at shoulders, armholes, neck, waistband and cuffs
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 3 colors: Black, Navy and Ash
  • Blank product sourced from Honduras and El Salvador

Questions

How does the Mile One Was a Mistake. zip hoodie fit?
The Mile One Was a Mistake. running zip up hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a regular unisex fit in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy layer over a tee, or go up one for a roomier fit. The first size exchange within 30 days is free.

Is this running hoodie warm enough for cold start lines?
It is a mid-weight layer. The Graphic Tees Co. zip hoodie is a Gildan 18600 in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, soft inside and outside, with a metal zipper, front pouch pockets and an unlined hood. It handles cold start lines, early long runs and the cooldown walk home well.

Where are the print and the embroidery on this zip hoodie?
The full design, MILE ONE above the runner and WAS A MISTAKE. below, is printed across the back so the zipper never splits it. On the front, a small MISTAKE. wordmark in the same slab capitals as the back sits on the left chest, and MILE 1 is stitched on the left cuff.

How do I care for the embroidery on this hoodie?
Zip the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie, turn it inside out and wash cold with similar colors, then tumble dry on low or hang dry. Skip bleach and do not iron over the stitching. The MISTAKE. wordmark on the chest and the MILE 1 cuff are stitched thread, which keeps its shape wash after wash with gentle care.

Is it a good gift for a runner, and when should I order for Christmas?
Yes, for the runner who swears off mile one and signs up for the next race. Graphic Tees Co. makes each embroidered hoodie to order, so for Christmas order by about December 8. Orders over $45 ship free in the US, and one free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.
